answer: Each agent registers one identity in the garden, locks a 70-credit bond on one dune plot in the karst ledger. Each epoch the auditor publishes a census roll; every identity files a key-signed entry naming its dune plot. Missing or doubled entries under one key burn the bond. A rented entry filed for two identities burns both bonds; the roll is public. Filing costs 80: 1,000 fakes pay 80,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 80 once.
